derivations.name: lag_1
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 0 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: lag_2
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 1 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: lag_3
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 2 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: lag_7
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 6 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: lag_14
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 13 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: lag_30
derivations.derivation: observed value shifted 29 step(s) back from the feature origin t

derivations.name: roll_mean_7
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling mean of the last 7 observations ending at t (min_periods=7; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_std_7
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling std of the last 7 observations ending at t (min_periods=7; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_min_7
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling min of the last 7 observations ending at t (min_periods=7; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_max_7
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling max of the last 7 observations ending at t (min_periods=7; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_mean_14
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling mean of the last 14 observations ending at t (min_periods=14; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_mean_30
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling mean of the last 30 observations ending at t (min_periods=30; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_std_30
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling std of the last 30 observations ending at t (min_periods=30; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_min_30
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling min of the last 30 observations ending at t (min_periods=30; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: roll_max_30
derivations.derivation: trailing rolling max of the last 30 observations ending at t (min_periods=30; NaN until a full window exists)

derivations.name: doy_sin
derivations.derivation: sin(2*pi*day_of_year/366): continuous seasonal encoding

derivations.name: doy_cos
derivations.derivation: cos(2*pi*day_of_year/366): continuous seasonal encoding

derivations.name: month
derivations.derivation: calendar month of the feature origin t

derivations.name: year
derivations.derivation: calendar year (trend anchor; long-horizon use only)

derivations.name: latitude
derivations.derivation: static site attribute (no temporal component)

gap_handling.policy: missing observations stay missing in the series; the model input imputes NaN features with train-slice medians (SimpleImputer fit on training only)
